criteria.evidence: Red-first proof executed for real (not reasoned about) across 7 reviewer rounds of self-attack: a fabricated invented primitive (unlisted sk-tag/class, e.g. an sk-auth-panel-shaped element and unowned sk- classes) planted into rendered output was confirmed caught by the derived check before being reverted, each round. Documented self-attacks that were actually run and measured include: document.body-scope gap (documentElement-appended sibling), case-sensitive prefix bypass, shadow-root-before-append gap, canary forgeable via instance-shadowed classList.add, Set.prototype.has global patch defeating the canary, window.__skPrimitiveWatch decoy reassignment, and same-origin iframe invisibility (incl. nested iframe, iframe-in-shadow-root, shadow-root-in-iframe, iframe-appended-after-canary-read) -- each found a real gap, each was closed, and closure was re-attacked before being accepted. Four residual floors disclosed in pattern-composition-lib.mjs comments: mutation deferred past the 500ms observation window, mode:'closed' shadow roots (platform; zero customized built-ins repo-wide per grep), cross-origin iframes (platform, Same-Origin Policy), and a whole-page Node.prototype.appendChild patch that would have to faithfully relay real appends to avoid breaking the page. WP01 approved after 7 full reviewer passes with all findings closed.
